reviewer.subject: Final standalone FormSeed3D GLB renders for WP27Ar5, WP23Ar5, WP29Ar5 and WP82Ar6 at the preserved source checkpoints, as described by the requester. I did not see any checkpoint, GLB or render-evidence hash myself.

evidence.1000: In front-three-quarter and top, the burn field is a broad radial char on the upper face, darkest around the square cavity (top view, about x 570–785, y 140–430), and the two bores read clearly. In right, the three periodic albedo streak clusters are still present (about x 135–165, 240–300 and 365–405, y 400–545). Their contrast is low, as the brief accepts, and I treat the faintness as accepted. Left shows a smooth char gradient with no periodicity. Front is an almost uniform tan face with a dark top lip.
evidence.256: In right, the streaks are only faint smudges in the left third. In top and front-three-quarter, the cavity and bores still read cleanly. In rear-three-quarter, the char wraps the rear face and the part reads as a burned block.
evidence.128: In right, the streaks are not legible. In front-three-quarter and top, the part reads as a tan block with a dark cavity and two bores.

nonBlockingObservations: In 1000-top, each bore has a stair-stepped crescent highlight at its upper rim (about x 200–360, y 615–690 and x 565–715, y 615–680). This looks like low-segment cylinder faceting. It is faintly visible in 256-top and gone at 128.
In 1000-front, there is a very faint lighter vertical band on the front face (about x 700–760, y 390–620). It may be a texture seam or a gradient step. It is not visible at 256.
